events.title: 112th Saint Agrippina di Mineo Feast: Grand Procession
events.description: Final day of the free North End feast, built around the Grand Procession at 12:30PM — a life-size statue of Saint Agrippina carried through the streets on the shoulders of 20 members of the Benefit Society, with bands and confetti. Free.

events.title: Free Shakespeare on the Common: A Midsummer Night's Dream (Sunday Matinee)
events.description: Rare daytime matinee of Commonwealth Shakespeare Company's free A Midsummer Night's Dream on Boston Common — the easiest performance to bring younger kids to. Audio described with a tactile tour. Free and open to the public.

events.title: 2026 Charles River Jazz Festival
events.description: The Boston Jazz Foundation's sixth annual Charles River Jazz Festival moves to the DCR Hatch Memorial Shell on the Esplanade, with a full day of Boston-based and world-renowned jazz, hip-hop, and funk acts plus local art and food vendors. General admission is free with registration; the park opens at 11:30 AM and music starts at noon. Rain or shine.

events.title: 2026 Boston Arts Festival (Saturday)
events.description: Boston's only fine arts and live music festival devoted exclusively to Boston-area talent, held in the historic waterfront setting of Christopher Columbus Park. Family friendly and always free, with juried artists showing and selling work alongside a full day of local musicians. Rain or shine.

events.title: 2026 Boston Arts Festival (Sunday)
events.description: Day two of the Boston Arts Festival at Christopher Columbus Park on the waterfront: juried Boston-area artists showing and selling their work, plus live music from local musicians all day. Family friendly and always free, rain or shine.

events.title: Cambridge Carnival Festival and Parade
events.description: Cambridge Carnival International is a free Caribbean-style cultural festival with a grand costume parade, music, international food and family activities, drawing roughly 100,000 attendees.
